authority_basis.summary: Notify Nima of the radial-Rees equator result.

operations.title: Benincasa identifies the physical boundary inside the four-site vanishing sphere
operations.body: Entry 1169/event 938 restores the lower Gram term in the radial Rees chart. The exceptional equation is omega^2=det(G)-vhat^T adj(G)vhat, with real vanishing S3. In physical three spatial dimensions the three external momenta span loop space, so K=det(G) ell_perp^2=0 and the literal radial chain lands at omega=0: the equatorial S2. Thus the source reaches the vanishing-cycle boundary but does not yet choose either hemisphere or a primitive oriented S3. The missing datum is dimensional/transverse continuation or source-derived sheet gluing, not a carrier cell.
